checks.name: Binary-Artifacts
checks.reason: Executables committed to the tree as it stands.

checks.name: CI-Tests
checks.reason: The share of the ~30 most recent commits a CI system reported a result on.

checks.name: Code-Review
checks.reason: The share of the ~30 most recent commits that carry an approval.

checks.name: Dangerous-Workflow
checks.reason: Dangerous patterns in the workflow files as they stand.

checks.name: Dependency-Update-Tool
checks.reason: Whether an update tool is configured in the tree.

checks.name: License
checks.reason: Whether a recognised license file is present.

checks.name: Maintained
checks.reason: Commit and issue activity over the previous 90 days.

checks.name: Pinned-Dependencies
checks.reason: Whether every dependency the tree declares is pinned.

checks.name: SAST
checks.reason: The share of the ~30 most recent merged pull requests a SAST tool ran on.

checks.name: Security-Policy
checks.reason: Whether the committed security policy is present and specific.

checks.name: Token-Permissions
checks.reason: The permissions the workflow files grant.

checks.name: Vulnerabilities
checks.reason: Advisories open against the dependencies the checkout resolves.

checks.name: Signed-Releases
checks.reason: The share of the 30 most recent releases whose artifacts are signed.

checks.name: Branch-Protection
checks.reason: The protection rules the default and release branches carry.

excluded.Contributors: Organization diversity is not a repository engineering control.
excluded.CII-Best-Practices: An OpenSSF badge is a separate adoption decision.
excluded.Fuzzing: Fuzzing adoption is a separate policy decision.
excluded.Packaging: Releases publish images rather than registry packages.
